verdict.rationale: Dynadot publishes a documented API with 120+ actions for domain management and also an official MCP server that explicitly supports 'Check a domain name availability' calls, so agents/code can programmatically check availability. However, no explicit rate-limit documentation is given, no OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (404s), and the API docs don't explicitly list domain-check as one of the enumerated actions outside the MCP context. Missing for 10: explicit rate-limit specs, a machine-readable API schema (OpenAPI), and clearer API-level (non-MCP) documentation of the availability-check endpoint.
